articulation.label: time
articulation.alt: time: /t/ → /aɪ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ɪ/: Glide up and forward; narrow the jaw gap.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
